#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() : out(cout) {}
    
    class Input {
    private:
        static const int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 15;
        unsigned char buf[BUF_SIZE];
        int idx, len;
        FILE* in;
        
    public:
        Input(FILE* f) : in(f), idx(0), len(0) {}
        
        int nextChar() {
            if (idx >= len) {
                len = fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, in);
                idx = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[idx++];
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            int c;
            while ((c = nextChar()) <= 32 && c != -1);
            if (c == -1) return -1;
            int x = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                x = x * 10 + c - '0';
                c = nextChar();
            }
            return x;
        }
    };
    
    Input input;
    ostream& out;
    
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    int N, M;
    vector<int> pi, dist, prevEdge;
    vector<int> from, to, xorVal, cost;
    vector<int> cap;
    
    void build(int nodes, int edges) {
        adj.assign(nodes, vector<int>());
        pi.assign(nodes, INF);
        dist.assign(nodes, 0);
        prevEdge.assign(nodes, 0);
        from.assign(edges, 0);
        to.assign(edges, 0);
        xorVal.assign(edges, 0);
        cost.assign(edges, 0);
        cap.assign(edges * 2, 0);
        M = 0;
    }
    
    void add(int u, int v, int capacity, int c) {
        int i = M++;
        from[i] = u;
        to[i] = v;
        xorVal[i] = u ^ v;
        cost[i] = c;
        cap[i * 2] = capacity;
        adj[u].push_back(i * 2);
        adj[v].push_back(i * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    vector<int> q;
    int qf, qb, ql;
    vector<bool> inq;
    
    void push(int x) {
        if (inq[x]) return;
        if (qf + qb == (int)q.size()) {
            if (ql * 2 <= (int)q.size()) {
                vector<int> newQ(q.begin() + qf, q.begin() + qf + ql);
                q = newQ;
            } else {
                vector<int> newQ(q.size() * 2);
                copy(q.begin() + qf, q.begin() + qf + ql, newQ.begin());
                q = newQ;
            }
            qf = 0;
        }
        q[qf + qb++] = x;
        inq[x] = true;
    }
    
    int pop() {
        int x = q[qf++];
        ql--;
        inq[x] = false;
        return x;
    }
    
    bool spfa(int s, int t) {
        fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        qf = qb = 0;
        ql = 0;
        inq.assign(pi.size(), false);
        push(s);
        
        while (ql > 0) {
            int u = pop();
            int nd = dist[u] + 1;
            
            for (int e : adj[u]) {
                if (cap[e] > 0) {
                    int idx = e >> 1;
                    int c = (e & 1) == 0 ? cost[idx] : -cost[idx];
                    int np = pi[u] + c;
                    int v = u ^ xorVal[idx];
                    
                    if (pi[v] > np || (pi[v] == np && dist[v] > nd)) {
                        pi[v] = np;
                        dist[v] = nd;
                        prevEdge[v] = e;
                        push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pi[t] != INF;
    }
    
    void augmentUnit(int s, int t) {
        for (int v = t; v != s; v ^= xorVal[prevEdge[v] >> 1]) {
            int e = prevEdge[v];
            cap[e]--;
            cap[e ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            augmentUnit(s, t);
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            total += cost[i] * cap[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    void process() {
        int n = input.nextInt();
        int m = input.nextInt();
        int k = input.nextInt();
        int c = input.nextInt();
        int d = input.nextInt();
        
        vector<int> special(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            special[i] = input.nextInt() - 1;
        }
        
        vector<vector<int>> g(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            g[i].reserve(n);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = input.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = input.nextInt() - 1;
            g[u].push_back(v);
            g[v].push_back(u);
        }
        
        int T = k + 1;
        int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
        int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
        
        build(totalNodes, totalEdges);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * T + t;
                for (int w : g[i]) {
                    int v = w * T + t + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        add(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * T + t;
                int v = u + 1;
                add(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            add(totalNodes - 1, special[i] * T, 1, 0);
        }
        
        out << minCostFlow(totalNodes - 1, 0 * T + T - 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.input = CF1187G::Input(stdin);
    solver.process();
    return 0;
}
